room_rent.note: Up to Sum Insured; no room rent sub-limit specified for Classic plan

icu.note: Up to Sum Insured; no ICU sub-limit specified

copayment.note: Applies to insured persons aged 61 years and above being covered for the first time; continues at renewal

sub_limits.note: Cataract: 10% of SI max ₹75,000/eye; Lasik: up to ₹30,000 both eyes (after 3yr wait); Bariatric: 50% SI max ₹5L; Maternity sub-limits apply

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for cataract, hernia, hydrocele, etc.; 36 months for rheumatoid arthritis, joint replacement, Lasik, gout, osteoporosis

maternity.display: Covered (24mo wait if both spouses covered)
maternity.note: Normal delivery: ₹25,000 (3L SI), ₹30,000 (5L/10L SI); C-section: ₹25,000 (3L), ₹35,000 (5L), ₹50,000 (10L); 24mo wait if both spouses covered, 36mo if only female covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% added per claim-free year; reduces at same rate if claim made; max 100% of SI

restoration.note: Triggered on second claim in policy year; available for same or new illness; cannot be used for maternity

domiciliary.note: Home Health Care up to 20% of SI via empanelled provider on cashless basis

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy; in-patient AYUSH hospital only; up to SI

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments including robotic surgery, oral chemo, intravitreal injections, stem cell therapy etc.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items excluded (Annexure III)

global_cover.note: Medical Treatment Abroad not applicable under Classic plan

notable_exclusions: OPD cover limited to mental/psychiatric illness only; no global cover; no infertility cover; external congenital anomaly excluded; STDs (non-HIV) excluded
